acceptance: Every portal page is on the kit, in migrated-pages.json, with no header paragraph
No money math in portal page code (monthlyTotalCents, balanceCents come from the domain; unit test)
"Needs you" shows the right first item (late bill → Pay now, unsigned rental → Sign, due soon → Open bill)
Rentals' ending and renewal forms open in sheets and call the same actions (browser test)
Repairs ?request=repair and ?request=pickup open the right sheet; repair wording never says "Report a problem"
Bills tabs and property filter work from the loaded statement; Pay now uses the existing route
Customer A never reaches B's data through any portal page, action or download (extended isolation tests)
Every new string has Spanish; kit words appear in Spanish when Spanish is active (test)
axe + keyboard at 360, 390, 820, 1280, 1920 px, light and dark; no sideways scrolling
ci green at the exact head; every review comment read
invariants: Every portal read and action resolves the customer from the signed-in user id; a customer id is never accepted from the URL; an address param only narrows within the customer's own addresses
Money stays integer cents through existing calculation functions; no financial math in UI code
Pay now keeps using the existing /account/billing/invoice/{id}/pay route; no Stripe path, webhook or payment-state behavior changes (docs/AI-PR-READ-FIRST.md honored and stated in the PR)
Spanish strings are added for every new English string in the same commit; Spanish display stays off until the reviewed copy is re-recorded (IN-83) — merging never waits on the translator review
The legal English terms readback, consent records, the privacy retention sentence and the printable bill document keep their legal wording (allow-listed with reasons)
Kit components default to English words, so the desk needs no change; only the portal shell passes translated kit words
No live payments, live SMS or live customer email is turned on; no production data is touched
next: PORTAL-1 built and verified locally (2026-10-30); the pull request is the merge lap (CI at the exact head is the browser evidence — the local production build was OOM-killed under multi-lane box load, declared in the PR). On merge, a close-out records PR marks the card complete.
outcome: Customer portal redesign in one PR: every page under src/app/account (Home, Rentals, Repairs, Bills + the bill page, Properties, Account + Privacy) moves onto the kit with the portal dictionary (section 3 of the spec), the kit words provider makes kit fixed words translatable and the portal shell passes the Spanish set, money totals move out of page code into src/domains/agreements/totals.ts and the workspace reads, the duplicate <main> is fixed, repair wording becomes 'Ask for a repair', header paragraphs become InfoTips, and the spec's tests land (agreement totals, kit words, extended customer isolation, portal home workspace, new e2e/portal.spec.ts). Same URLs, same server actions, same domain reads, same Stripe paths; Spanish display stays governed by the IN-83 reviewed-copy rule.
